summary.business_type: Free web tool (SaaS) + paid macOS desktop app with SEO content blog
top_findings: Global canonical hardcoded to homepage on every route — all ranking signals collapse
Pure client-side rendering with no SSR/prerender — crawlers risk indexing loading states
robots.txt blocks all major AI crawlers (GPTBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, ClaudeBot) + ai-train=no
Soft-404s: catch-all rewrite returns 200 HTML for every unknown URL and missing asset
Only one JSON-LD block site-wide; no BlogPosting, FAQPage, SoftwareApplication, or Organization
5 tool landing pages are near-duplicates (shared FAQ, benefits, comparison table)
139KB logo.webp preloaded high-priority; hero.webp (93KB) preloaded globally but used only on /download
quick_wins: Add FAQPage JSON-LD for the homepage FAQ section
Add SoftwareApplication JSON-LD to /download for the $8.99 app
Add BlogPosting + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD to blog posts
Stop global hero.webp preload and recompress logo.webp (139KB -> ~20KB)
Set preload=none + lazy load the four autoplay MP4s on /download (~2MB)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt and sitemap.xml present and valid; live sitemap includes all 9 blog posts
HSTS enabled, HTTPS via Cloudflare, NEL/report-to configured
SPA links use data-discover for crawler-friendly navigation

findings.title: Canonical hardcoded to homepage on every route
findings.description: index.html:55 sets rel=canonical to https://webpit.site/; useSEO.ts never updates it. Verified: rendered /blog/<slug> declares homepage canonical while rendering its own H1. All 9 posts + /download + tool pages point canonical at the homepage.
findings.recommendation: Set per-route canonical in useSEO (fast) and ideally emit it in prerendered raw HTML (proper).

findings.title: No SSR/prerendering — content depends on JS + async Sanity fetch
findings.description: Every route serves the same ~4.8KB shell. A 1.8s headless render of a blog post captured only the nav (Blog/Mac App/About WebP) — no article, no H1. Google can render JS but render-budget pressure yields empty pages.
findings.recommendation: Pre-render routes with vite-plugin-prerender or vite-ssg; reuse the sitemap script's Sanity query to bake blog posts into static HTML.

findings.title: Soft-404s from catch-all rewrite
findings.description: vercel.json rewrites /(.*) -> / so unknown URLs and missing assets return 200 text/html. Verified: /nonexistent-page-xyz, /apple-touch-icon.png, /downshare.webp, /favicon.ico, /llms.txt all 200 HTML.
findings.recommendation: Return true 404 for unknown paths (middleware/notFound), and add real files for referenced assets.

findings.title: Missing/404 asset references in head
findings.description: index.html references /apple-touch-icon.png (absent) and /download uses og:image /downshare.webp (absent) — both serve the SPA shell as 200 HTML.
findings.recommendation: Add real apple-touch-icon.png, favicon.ico, and a valid /download OG image to public/.

findings.title: Committed sitemap is stale; regeneration depends on manual build
findings.description: public/sitemap.xml in repo lists 3 of 9 posts (lastmod May 31). Regenerated only when `npm run build` runs npm run sitemap; a Sanity fetch failure silently ships the stale file.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate and commit fresh sitemap; move generation into CI/deploy hook.

findings.title: URL variant inconsistency (sitemap vs canonical)
findings.description: Sitemap uses https://webpit.site (no slash); canonical and OG use https://webpit.site/.
findings.recommendation: Standardize on trailing-slash form in the sitemap generator.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Substantive homepage copy: how-to, comparison table, FAQ, benefits
9 relevant blog posts with related/prev-next internal linking
Thorough Privacy, Terms, and Refund pages

findings.title: 5 tool landing pages are near-duplicates
findings.description: /png-to-webp, /jpg-to-webp, /jpeg-to-webp, /gif-to-webp, /compress-webp share the same FAQ, benefits, and comparison table; only heading/description/uploadDesc differ (Home.tsx seoData).
findings.recommendation: Write unique FAQ + benefit copy per format; use unique FAQPage schema per page.

findings.title: Weak E-E-A-T signals
findings.description: No About page, no author pages/bios on blog posts, no company page; only JSON-LD Person node with name. No Organization schema with sameAs to X/LinkedIn/Reddit.
findings.recommendation: Add /about, author bylines + pages, Organization schema, and profile links.

findings.title: Blog posts lack author/date trust signals in rendered content
findings.description: BlogPost.tsx renders a date but no author byline; SEO description falls back to a generic string when post.description is absent.
findings.recommendation: Render author + publish date and require descriptions in Sanity.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: useSEO hook sets per-route title/description/OG client-side
Well-formed heading hierarchy on blog and download pages

findings.title: All metadata is JS-injected; raw HTML identical across routes
findings.description: Raw <title>/<description>/OG tags on every route are the homepage's. No-JS crawlers and social scrapers get homepage metadata for every page.
findings.recommendation: Pre-render per-route metadata (ties to Technical C2).

findings.title: Blog posts never set unique og:title/og:image/canonical
findings.description: BlogPost.tsx only updates document.title + meta description manually; og:image stays logo.webp, og:title stays homepage default (verified in rendered output).
findings.recommendation: Route blog posts through useSEO with post title, description, image, and canonical.

findings.title: Homepage has no H1
findings.description: The / route's hero is the logo; no h1 carries the primary keyword.
findings.recommendation: Add an H1 (e.g. 'Free WebP Image Converter — Fast & Private') in Home.tsx.

findings.title: Raw title vs OG title inconsistency
findings.description: Raw <title> 'Fast & Private' vs og:title 'Fast, Private & Free' in index.html.
findings.recommendation: Align both to the same string.

findings.title: Footer links use rel=noreferrer without noopener
findings.description: App.tsx footer social anchors: rel='noreferrer' strips referrer data.
findings.recommendation: Use rel='noopener' (or noopener noreferrer).

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid WebApplication + Offer + Person JSON-LD on homepage (validated by render)

findings.title: No FAQPage schema despite homepage FAQ section
findings.description: Home.tsx:551-569 renders 4 FAQs with no corresponding FAQPage markup.
findings.recommendation: Add FAQPage JSON-LD matching the rendered Q&As.

findings.title: No SoftwareApplication schema for the paid Mac app
findings.description: /download sells a $8.99 app; only the free WebApplication is marked up (index.html).
findings.recommendation: Add SoftwareApplication + Offer on /download.

findings.title: No BlogPosting/Article schema on blog posts
findings.description: Blog posts have no Article markup — no datePublished, headline, image, or author signals for rich results.
findings.recommendation: Inject BlogPosting + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD per post.

findings.title: No Organization schema with sameAs
findings.description: Social profiles (X, LinkedIn, Reddit) exist in footer but aren't linked via schema.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization JSON-LD with logo + sameAs.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Async font loading with preload+onload swap
GA4 deferred 2s, route-level code splitting, manualChunks
Splash screen inline for fast FCP

findings.title: hero.webp (93KB) preloaded globally but only used on /download
findings.description: index.html:26 preloads hero.webp fetchpriority=high on every page; homepage never displays it.
findings.recommendation: Preload hero.webp only on /download; drop the global preload.

findings.title: logo.webp is 139KB — heavy LCP candidate
findings.description: The header logo (LCP candidate on homepage) is preloaded high-priority at 139KB.
findings.recommendation: Recompress to <=20KB; add srcset/sizes.

findings.title: ~2MB of autoplay MP4s load immediately on /download
findings.description: batch-processing.mp4 777KB, menubar-agent.mp4 435KB, clipboard-conversion.mp4 431KB, watch-folders.mp4 330KB start loading at page load.
findings.recommendation: preload='none' + lazy load / play-on-intersect.

findings.title: BlogPost chunk is 638KB
findings.description: react-syntax-highlighter pulls large prism styles into the blog chunk.
findings.recommendation: Use per-language prism imports or a lighter highlighter.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Well-structured, citable blog content (headings, tables, code blocks)

findings.title: robots.txt blocks all major AI crawlers
findings.description: Live robots.txt (Cloudflare-managed) disallows GPTBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, ClaudeBot, Bytespider, Amazonbot, Applebot-Extended, meta-externalagent and sets Content-Signal ai-train=no, use=reference. Site is absent from ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews, and Claude.
findings.recommendation: Reconsider blocking; at minimum allow Google-Extended/GPTBot/ClaudeBot or move to an AI-permissive policy. Deliberate if intentional.

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: https://webpit.site/llms.txt returns the SPA shell as 200 HTML.
findings.recommendation: Add public/llms.txt summarizing the tool + key pages.

findings.title: Content is JS-rendered — unrenderable by most AI crawlers
findings.description: Even if unblocked, non-JS crawlers would only retrieve the splash shell.
findings.recommendation: Prerendering (Technical C2) also unlocks AI crawlability.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Blog cards use Sanity-resized images with alt={post.title}
Most images have width/height attributes preventing CLS

findings.title: Blog body images use generic alt='Blog content'
findings.description: BlogPost.tsx:276 renders every inline Portable Text image with the same meaningless alt.
findings.recommendation: Pass the Sanity asset alt/caption from the image type.

findings.title: OG image broken on /download and non-unique elsewhere
findings.description: og:image /downshare.webp doesn't exist (serves HTML). Blog posts share homepage logo.webp.
findings.recommendation: Create real 1200x630 OG images; set per-page og:image.

findings.title: Missing favicon.ico and apple-touch-icon.png files
findings.description: Both referenced paths return 200 text/html (SPA shell).
findings.recommendation: Ship real files in public/.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Add prerendering/SSG for route-level HTML and metadata
Eliminate soft-404s and ship real files for broken asset references
Decide AI-crawler policy and update robots.txt accordingly

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add FAQPage, SoftwareApplication, BlogPosting, Organization schema
Unique OG/social images per page incl. blog posts
De-duplicate the 5 tool landing pages with unique FAQ/benefits
Fix image performance (logo.webp, hero.webp preload, srcset) and blog alt text

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add About page, author bylines, Organization E-E-A-T signals
Automate sitemap regeneration and commit fresh sitemap
Expand content cluster around WebP/image optimization; internal links tool->blog->download

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Connect Search Console + CrUX for field CWV data
Baseline canonical/OG/schema drift checks across deploys
